question: The Matrice 4T ASRS report proves it lost its link and crashed. What should it have done according to the manual?
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

intake.focus: loss of control link / signal loss
intake.reason: ASRS report claims loss of link and crash; what the manual prescribes

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance requires emergency or contingency procedures after loss of control link and to regain VLOS as soon as practicable; FAA guidance also says two certificated remote pilots may transfer control only if both can maintain VLOS without loss of control; the remote PIC remains responsible for safe operation. The DJI Matrice 4T manual states that on signal loss the aircraft will auto-initiate RTH if Signal Lost Action is set to RTH, and that braking/hover then Original Route RTH can occur when vision conditions are unsuitable. Incident reports: no usable evidence found in the approved collection for DJI Matrice 4T incident reports.
